# BeltManager

> Complete martial arts school management software for dojos, karate schools, BJJ academies, and MMA gyms.

BeltManager helps martial arts school owners automate scheduling, billing, and student tracking — saving 10+ hours per week. BeltManager is free for up to 25 students, with paid plans from £29 a month ($29 in the US): Club £29 (up to 75 students), School £49 (up to 150), Academy £79 (unlimited), every feature on every plan, no setup fee and no contract. Plans take effect 1 April 2027; schools that join before then are free until 31 March 2027, then get 50% off a paid plan for 12 months. Sign up at https://app.beltmanager.com/signin.

- [Dojo Management Software](https://beltmanager.com/dojo-management-software/): Full product overview covering class scheduling, student management, belt tracking, and billing
- [Pricing](https://beltmanager.com/pricing/): Free up to 25 students; Club, School and Academy plans from £29 a month; every feature on every plan
- [About](https://beltmanager.com/about/): Founder story and product mission
- [Contact](https://beltmanager.com/contact/): Get in touch with the team

## Feature Pages

- [Martial Arts Scheduling Software](https://beltmanager.com/martial-arts-scheduling-software/): Class and instructor scheduling with conflict detection
- [Martial Arts Billing Software](https://beltmanager.com/martial-arts-billing-software/): Automated invoicing, payment recording, and overdue reminders
- [Martial Arts CRM](https://beltmanager.com/martial-arts-crm/): Student and prospect management, attendance tracking, and communication tools

## Vertical Pages

- [Karate School Software](https://beltmanager.com/karate-school-software/): Management tools tailored for karate dojos and schools
- [BJJ Gym Software](https://beltmanager.com/bjj-gym-software/): Software for Brazilian jiu-jitsu gyms and academies
- [MMA Gym Software](https://beltmanager.com/mma-gym-software/): Software for mixed martial arts gyms and fight teams

## Tools

- [Dojo Revenue Calculator](https://beltmanager.com/dojo-revenue-calculator/): Free calculator to model gym revenue, class profitability, instructor costs, and growth projections using UK industry benchmarks
